title: GET /books/{id} is unreachable under axum 0.7 route syntax
evidence: Handler get_book exists at src/main.rs:91 and is registered at src/main.rs:118 via `.route("/books/{id}", ...)`, but Cargo.lock pins axum 0.7.9 / matchit 0.7.3 where path params are `:id` and `{id}` is a LITERAL segment. A request to /books/1 returns 404. Empirically: test `creates_and_reads_book` (src/main.rs:159) asserts OK and fails; scorer test_coverage=0.333 (1/3).
suggestion: Change the route to `/books/:id` (axum 0.7) or bump axum to 0.8 in Cargo.toml so `{id}` is a capture.

title: PUT /books/{id} is unreachable under axum 0.7 route syntax
evidence: Handler update_book exists at src/main.rs:97, registered at src/main.rs:118. Under matchit 0.7.3 `{id}` is literal, so /books/1 never matches update_book. Test `updates_deletes_and_reports_missing_books` (src/main.rs:185) asserts 200 OK and fails with 404.
suggestion: Same fix as R4: use `/books/:id` or upgrade axum to 0.8.

title: DELETE /books/{id} is unreachable under axum 0.7 route syntax
evidence: Handler delete_book exists at src/main.rs:106, registered at src/main.rs:118. Under matchit 0.7.3 `{id}` is literal, so delete_book is unreachable for /books/1. Covered by the failing test at src/main.rs:186 (expects 204 NO_CONTENT).
suggestion: Same fix as R4: use `/books/:id` or upgrade axum to 0.8.

title: 2 of 3 tests fail: axum 0.7 pin vs 0.8 route syntax
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.333 (scorer built with deps and ran tests; 1/3 pass).
